subject: Mobile Development
title: Google Play vs. the App Store
description: A micro-lesson that makes Google Play vs. the App Store usable.

hook.text: Google Play has more apps. The App Store makes more money. The rivalry defines mobile.

buildup.text: Google Play allows sideloading and alternative stores. Apple does not — by design.

discovery.text: iOS users spend roughly twice as much on apps as Android users on average.

twist.text: Both stores take a 30% cut, but both face antitrust pressure to lower their fees.

climax.text: The two stores control how billions of people discover and pay for software.

punchline.text: Two gatekeepers control all mobile software.

quiz.question: Which store generates more revenue per user?
